review_comment: The raw_html method returns user-provided HTML content without encoding when the skip_html option is disabled, creating an HTML injection vulnerability. While this change only adds a self parameter, the underlying vulnerability allows injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript into the rendered output. Ensure the skip_html option defaults to true or implement mandatory HTML sanitization before returning user content.

The added key normalization enables collisions between distinct markdown keys through case folding and whitespace collapsing. While this affects link/footnote resolution, the mechanism aligns more with CWE-838 (Inadequate Validation of Specified Index, Position, or Offset in Input) than command injection. Consider adding collision detection or maintaining original key forms for security-sensitive lookups.
